svg.title: BrewLite - Activity Diagram: From Menu to Paid Order (D-07)

g.text: BrewLite - Activity Diagram: From Menu to Paid Order (D-07)
Choose size S, M or L and toppings
Choose Wallet or Card and confirm
Collect the drink at the counter
Leave the order unpaid or cancel it
Show detail page with sizes and toppings
Show updated price for the chosen options
Show empty cart and link to menu
Store JWT and keep the cart
Send POST /orders with JWT, items and optional promotion code
Show error or ask to sign in, cart kept
Show the out-of-stock item, cart kept
Send POST /payments with JWT, order id, method and key
Show confirmation with order id and PAID
Verify JWT and validate the request
Reject with 401 or 400, no order created
Load current prices, options and promotion
An invalid or expired promotion code
is rejected and the customer may
Roll back, no order created, stock unchanged
Save Order as PENDING with its items
Verify JWT, validate the request, load the order
JWT valid, order found, owned by caller and payable?
Look up payment by user and Idempotency-Key
Record the payment, move order to PAID
Swimlanes: Customer, Next.js UI, NestJS API and Database, Payment Service (mock).
Red = failure, rejection or exception path.
Decision diamonds close at the matching endif or repeat while.
